summary: The documents define a user control named 'History' within the HSPnet application. This control handles various aspects of displaying and refreshing historical data related to educational topics (ETopic) for a user session.
purpose: The purpose of the 'History' user control is to manage and display history data related to educational topics within a user's session, providing functionalities like search, print, and refresh.

fields.name: UserSession
fields.description: HSPnetSession representing the current user's session

fields.name: HistoryType
fields.description: Type of history to be displayed

fields.name: DisplayButtons
fields.description: Indicates whether buttons should be displayed

workflows.name: Select History Data
steps: If not null, set input parameters for ETopicID and HistoryType.
Set visibility for refresh buttons based on DisplayButtons.

workflows.name: Search Command
steps: Cache the UserSession if it is not null.
Redirect to the current URL using YARP if enabled, otherwise use the full URL.

conditions: Check if UserSession is null before proceeding with data selection.
system_behavior: The control relies on HSPnetSession for managing user sessions.
Visibility of refresh buttons is conditional on DisplayButtons property.
exceptions: Operation is cancelled if UserSession is null during data selection.
